entities.summary: Jonathan Drouin is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the St. Louis Blues of the National Hockey League (NHL). Drouin was selected in the first round, third overall, by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the 2013 NHL entry draft. He has also played for the Montreal Canadiens, Colorado Avalanche, and New York Islanders.
